content: Clinical trials investigating the comparative effectiveness of various medications, as endorsed by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), have demonstrated that drugs such as empagliflozin, canagliflozin, dapagliflozin, liraglutide, and semaglutide exert beneficial effects on cardiovascular risk markers. Furthermore, ongoing trials are actively assessing the impact of additional therapeutic agents on a range of clinical outcomes, including atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) and renal disease.
